visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens on an outdoor clay tennis court under bright natural daylight. Two men, both wearing black baseball caps, are the focus; the man on the left is shirtless, revealing a highly muscular physique, while the man on the right wears a grey t-shirt with a small square logo on the chest. They perform a firm, high-energy handshake/arm-clasp, smiling at each other. The background features green windbreaks and a multi-story concrete building with bare trees. (2) A sudden cut shows a man in a black tank top and black shorts performing a tennis serve. He is positioned in the center of the clay court, reaching high with his racket to strike the yellow ball. The backdrop is a densely packed residential building with many windows and balconies, typical of an urban environment. (3) The scene shifts to night under bright, multi-bulb floodlights at an outdoor court. A man in a grey tank top is captured in mid-serve, his body extended as he strikes the ball. A tennis ball cart filled with balls and a ladder-style umpire chair are visible in the background against a dark sky and illuminated apartment blocks. (4) The scene transitions to a large indoor tennis stadium with a sophisticated metal truss ceiling and rows of blue spectator seating. A man in black athletic wear is seen from behind, completing a serve on a green hard court. A screen or window in the distance shows another court area. (5) Back at an outdoor clay court at night, the man in the grey tank top hits a powerful forehand. Numerous yellow tennis balls are scattered across the court surface. The overhead floodlights cast long shadows and create high contrast against the dark trees and buildings in the distance. (6) A tighter medium shot follows as the player executes another forehand stroke, swinging a yellow and black racket through the air. The lighting is focused on his movement, making the yellow ball stand out against the dark background. (7) The final phase is a wide shot of the clay court at night from a slightly elevated angle. The player in the foreground hits a forehand toward the net, while another person is visible far in the background on the opposite side. The court is messy with scattered tennis balls, illuminated by strong stadium lights.
